page.title: Anxiety Level
page.subtitle: 2 minutes · 7 questions
page.disclaimer: This test is a self-check tool and does not constitute a medical diagnosis.
page.description: The Anxiety Check is based on the international GAD-7 questionnaire and helps assess your level of anxiety.

form.rateLimitError: You have already submitted this check recently. Please try again later.
form.readyToSubmit: All questions answered. Submit when ready.

result.supportiveMessage: It looks like you may be experiencing high anxiety. Remember — you're not alone. Consider speaking with a mental health professional or someone you trust.

questions.q0: Feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge
questions.q1: Not being able to stop or control worrying
questions.q2: Worrying too much about different things
questions.q4: Being so restless that it is hard to sit still
questions.q6: Feeling afraid, as if something awful might happen

summary.minimal: Your responses suggest minimal anxiety. Keep maintaining healthy habits and routines.
summary.mild: Your responses suggest mild anxiety. Small lifestyle changes and relaxation practices can help.
summary.moderate: Your responses suggest moderate anxiety. Consider speaking with a mental health professional for additional support.
summary.severe: Your responses suggest high anxiety. We recommend reaching out to a mental health professional.
